subject: Add reveal password context menu for password fields
body:
Add reveal password context menu for password fields

- Right-click any password field in property grid shows 'Reveal Password' option
- Only appears when selected property has PasswordPropertyText attribute
- Requires master password to be configured
- Prompts for master password verification before revealing
- Shows password in a read-only dialog with Key icon
- Add 3 localization strings: RevealPassword, RevealPasswordDescription, RevealPasswordRequiresMasterPassword
- Update CHANGELOG

triage.rationale: Our fork already ships hardened reveal/copy with MasterPasswordGate + clipboard hygiene (0e7b9c75e, #128). This is weaker duplicate of existing feature.
